title: Assistance Services and Cover Extensions by Travel Protection Plans Plan
content:
Each Travel Protection Plans plan states whether a travel concierge service is included, how many hours a day the emergency assistance line is staffed for it, whether remote medical consultation is included, whether illness from a declared epidemic is covered rather than excluded, whether a terrorist incident at the destination is a covered cancellation reason, and whether loss arising from war or civil unrest is excluded.

| Plan | Travel concierge | Assistance line, hours a day | Remote medical consultation | Declared epidemic | Terrorist incident at destination | War and civil unrest |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Trip Basics Essential | not included | 12 | not included | excluded | not a covered reason | excluded |
| Trip Basics Standard | not included | 24 | included | excluded | not a covered reason | excluded |
| TripGuard Plus | not included | 24 | included | covered | covered reason | excluded |
| TripGuard Premier | included | 24 | included | covered | covered reason | excluded |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | included | 24 | included | covered | covered reason | excluded |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | not included | 24 | included | covered | covered reason | excluded |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | included | 24 | included | covered | covered reason | excluded |

Trip Basics Essential is the single plan whose assistance line is staffed 12 hours a day; on every other plan it is staffed 24 hours a day.

Loss arising from war or civil unrest is excluded on all seven plans without exception. The epidemic and terrorism entries move together across the range: both stand outside cover on the two Trip Basics plans and inside it on the remaining five.

The travel concierge service is carried by three plans — TripGuard Premier, Cancel For Any Reason Elite and Annual Multi-Trip Executive. Remote medical consultation is carried by six, Trip Basics Essential alone excepted.
